examples.text: He discovered later in life that he had developed a leather <w>fetish</w>.

examples.text: The tribe regarded the carved stone as a sacred <w>fetish</w> endowed with healing powers.

senses.sense_definition: A physical figure or carved effigy representing the spirit of a deity, human, or animal; an idol.

senses.sense_definition: A recurrent theme or hallmark fixation centered on a specific element.

examples.text: A recurring <w>fetish</w> for futuristic architecture is evident across all of the director's movies.
